goal_or_hypothesis: Identify the first B0/B1 action difference in changed local auctions and describe payoff by direction, role and offer band without using the frozen ISS campaign.
nearest_gate: Weakness-driven next bidding treatment after independent confirmation and R9 decision
smallest_intervention: Hash-pin the existing 100-deal local paired artifact, aggregate only first action divergence and deal-cluster payoff
invariants_to_preserve: No R9 strength look or frozen-worker modification
No local confirmation deal IDs used for training selection
No promotion or threshold tuning from exploratory subgroups
No additional B0 inference or competing compute
resource_bound: One 1.6 MB local read, no large write and no model inference
descriptive_finding: Of 71 changed pairs, 51 first changed PASS to CONTINUE; 48 first changes occurred at offers 18-24. Their deal-cluster mean deltas are negative locally, but these are post hoc overlapping strata from 100 deals.
next_on_success: Use disjoint predeclared train-only research and gameplay confirmation to test any low-bid/answerer treatment after the frozen R9 gate is decided
next_on_failure_or_inconclusive: Retain B0/B1 local result and reject this diagnostic as a selection signal
